CDP20.scope: Exact original multiple-fibre assertions and the singular-support distinction. No universal scheme-theoretic or irrational-parameter conclusion is inferred solely from their brief remarks.

Grauert_scope.scope: §7 Satz3 upper semicontinuity was distinguished from analytic closedness; the correction at p36 states that the general Satz2 failure set need not be closed. The proof here uses its separately derived finite holomorphic kernel matrix, not that unqualified failure-set claim.
